 Harris County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0040
 Brandon Knight, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
September 8, 2025
Plaintiff's counsel:
Carlos Fox, Carter & Smith Injury Lawyers
PARTIES
Plaintiff Brandon Knight is an individual residing in Texas who was the driver and sole occupant of a passenger vehicle involved
in the collision described below.
Defendant is an automobile insurance carrier authorized to transact business in the State of Texas. Defendant issued the policy
that provided uninsured and underinsured motorist coverage and related benefits to Plaintiff at the time of the loss.
FACTS
On May 29, 2024, Plaintiff was lawfully operating a vehicle on a roadway in Baytown, Texas. A second vehicle, operated by an
insured of Defendant, moved into the lane occupied by Plaintiff while changing lanes without signaling and without first
confirming that the lane was clear. The vehicles sideswiped one another, causing damage to the driver's side of Plaintiff's vehicle
and forcing Plaintiff to brake and steer abruptly to avoid a more serious impact.
Plaintiff reported the collision promptly and submitted a claim to Defendant under the applicable coverage. Defendant has not
paid the claim in full and has not provided a reasonable explanation for its position.
NEGLIGENCE
The insured driver owed Plaintiff and other motorists a duty to exercise ordinary care when changing lanes, including the duty to
check mirrors and blind spots, to signal intent, and to yield to traffic already in the lane. The insured driver breached that duty,
and that breach was a proximate cause of the collision and of Plaintiff's injuries. Defendant is liable for the insured driver's
negligence to the extent of the coverage owed under the policy and Texas law governing the handling of covered claims.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff suffered a strain to the lower back, which has caused pain, stiffness, reduced range of
motion, and difficulty with daily activities. Plaintiff has incurred medical expenses for evaluation and treatment and will likely
require further care. Plaintiff has also lost time from work and has suffered physical pain and mental anguish. Plaintiff seeks
recovery of damages in the amount of $125,000.00, together with pre-judgment and post-judgment interest, costs of court, and all
other relief to which Plaintiff may be entitled.
